India, watched for landslide — risk live, history remembered.

Do sawalon ka ek imaandar jawab: abhi India ke pahadi ilaakon me landslide ka risk kahan hai — GSI ke 21 forecast jile aur unki susceptibility, IMD ki tez baarish (asal trigger) ke saath — aur 1984 se 2026 tak ke 47 source-verified bade landslides ka archive. Pehle hi saaf kar dein: landslide ka koi live occurrence feed India me hai hi nahi — ye website risk dikhati hai, jhooti "live ghatna" kabhi nahi. Live risk map · GSI NLFC + susceptibility + IMD trigger · Oct 2026

Pahadi India — landslide ka risk abhi kahan hai?

Is map par aaj hue slides nahi hain — woh koi bhi imaandari se nahi dikha sakta, kyunki India me landslide ka real-time feed hai hi nahi. Is par hai asal risk: GSI ke National Landslide Forecasting Centre ke 21 jile jahan roz forecast banta hai (gehra bhoora diamond = operational, halka = experimental), unke aas-paas ki unchi susceptibility wali dhalaanein, aur IMD ki tez baarish (neeli boond) — kyunki baarish hi lagbhag har bade slide ka trigger hoti hai. Kisi diamond par tap karo — mitti-badal khulega: jile ka status, risk ka matlab, route aur escape route ke saath. 3D Globe wala view SIRF live risk ke liye hai — ghumte hue globe par sirf GSI diamonds aur baarish trigger dikhte hain, aur neeche LIVE RISK banner saaf batata hai ki abhi kahan kya sthiti hai (agar kahin kuch na ho raha ho toh globe bilkul shaant dikhega); puraane record-spots globe par hain hi nahi. Records dekhne ke liye 2D Map wala button dabao — wahan archive ke saare record-spots dikhte hain; kisi spot par tap karo, uski poori kahani khul jayegi. View har 5 minute me dobara scan hota hai.

Diamonds ka matlab — simple guide
Gehra bhoora diamond = GSI OPERATIONAL forecast jila — monsoon me roz bulletin. DHYAAN DO — tap karo, mitti-badal khulega.
Halka bhoora diamond = EXPERIMENTAL forecast jila — forecast abhi ground-testing me hai, SDMA ke saath share hota hai.
Neeli boond = IMD ki tez baarish — landslide ka trigger. Boond diamond ke paas ho toh risk sabse zyada.
Bhoora dhadakta spot = tumhari chuni hui jagah / khula hua record.

Koi date, mahina ya saal — bhooskhalan dhundho

Wayanad 2024 yahan anchor record hai — woh asal me landslide tha jo flash flood ke saath aaya; isiliye kuch jagah use baadh ki ghatna bhi kaha jata hai, lekin uski jaanen yahan sirf ek baar, isi archive ke total me gini gayi hain.

How this works

Landslide data — asal, dated, imaandaar

Live risk — aur uski seema

Sabse pehle woh baat jo har "live landslide" daave se pehle sunni chahiye: India me landslide ka koi real-time occurrence feed hai hi nahi. Isiliye is section ka live layer ek risk/forecast view hai — GSI ka National Landslide Forecasting Centre (NLFC, Kolkata) monsoon 2025 se 21 jilon ke liye roz bulletin deta hai: Darjeeling, Kalimpong aur Nilgiris operational, baaki 18 (Sikkim 6, Uttarakhand 4, Nagaland 3, Wayanad, Idukki, Kodagu, Shimla, Kinnaur) experimental. Uske neeche GSI ki national susceptibility mapping hai, aur IMD ki tez baarish trigger ke roop me — kyunki is archive ke lagbhag saare bade slides baarish ke baad hue. NRSC/ISRO ka Landslide Atlas (1998–2022, ~80,000 slides) historical inventory hai, live nahi — hum use waisa hi kehte hain.

The landslide archive — aur uski imaandari

Har record ki source usi ke page par linked hai. Teen baatein saaf-saaf: (1) Wayanad 2024 asal me ek landslide tha (flash flood ke saath) — woh yahan is archive ka anchor record hai, aur uski jaanen sirf yahin, ek hi baar gini gayi hain. (2) Kuch badi baadh ghatnaon (Kerala 2019, Maharashtra 2021, Himachal 2023) ke kul ankadon ke andar landslide mautain bhi ghuli hui hain — unhe yahan nahi laaya gaya, taaki koi maut do baar na gini jaye aur koi ankda andaze se na bane. (3) Kuch mashoor tolls par sources aaj bhi ek-mat nahi (Malpa 221 pakka ankda hai, kuch compilations ~380 kehte hain; Irshalwadi 84 NRSC/ISRO study se hai) — site sabse majboot source ka ankda dikhati hai. Landslide ki koi verified photo is archive ke paas nahi hai — isiliye har record apni source coverage se link hai, kisi doosri ghatna ki photo kabhi nahi lagayi gayi.

Bhumi — tumhari landslide madadgaar

Neeche Bhumi wala button dabao aur landslide par kuch bhi puchho: "Landslide ka live risk kya hai?", "Sabse badi landslide kaunsi thi?", "Wayanad 2024 me kya hua tha?", "Sadak par hue slides dikhao", ya "Bhooskhalan-prone ilaake me kya karein, kya na karein?" Ek pakki baat: Bhumi kabhi ye nahi kahegi ki usne koi slide "live detect" kiya — aisa feed India me hai hi nahi, aur woh ye seema khud batayegi. Type karke ya bol karke puchho.

In a real landslide emergency, call 112 (all emergencies).
This website is an information and awareness archive — it does not dispatch help, and it does not detect landslides live. No such live feed exists for India.

India Landslide Explorer

An honest live-risk watch for India’s hills — GSI forecast districts, susceptibility and the rain trigger — and a source-verified archive of the country’s major landslides, 1984–2026. Built so that these days are remembered with facts, and the next slope is watched earlier.

Data sources

  • GSI — National Landslide Forecasting Centre (NLFC) bulletins & susceptibility mapping
  • IMD — district rainfall & heavy-rain warnings (the trigger)
  • NRSC / ISRO Bhuvan — Landslide Atlas of India (historical inventory)
  • Incident records — GSI reports, state disaster-management records, peer-reviewed journals & national news (linked on each record)
